description:
HackBIOS 2k26 is a national-level hackathon bringing together the brightest young innovators, developers, and tech enthusiasts from across the country to solve real-world problems through technology.

*Our previous edition saw 350+ attendees come together for an incredible offline experience ,  a remarkable success that left a lasting impression on all who attended.*

**This year, HackBIOS 2k26 will be conducted in two rounds:**

Round 1 — Online Selection

 - Submit a PPT based on your idea/solution
- Choose from the following tracks: Healthcare, Web3/Blockchain, Web Development, Cybersecurity, AI/ML, FinTech, EdTech, and Open Innovation
- 📄 Only the provided PPT template will be accepted — submissions in any other format will not be considered
- 📄 ppt link - [https://drive.google.com/file/d/1xagMiVaa8v-QAU_-ByFGgzw45WfrpBKP/view?usp=drivesdk](https://drive.google.com/file/d/1xagMiVaa8v-QAU_-ByFGgzw45WfrpBKP/view?usp=drivesdk)

Round 2 — Offline Hackathon (24 Hrs)

- Shortlisted teams build & present a working prototype onsite 

**📁 A detailed guide and demo video are available to help you prepare — [https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1sz2XH2rJgvy8TrmQ468ALh2hkZBq9b9s?usp=sharing](https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1sz2XH2rJgvy8TrmQ468ALh2hkZBq9b9s?usp=sharing)**

 Why HackBIOS?
*More than a competition, HackBIOS is a hub of innovation, collaboration, and talent development  encouraging young minds to explore technology, engage with the latest innovations, and connect with vibrant tech communities.*

**Website link -** [https://www.hackbios.xyz/](https://www.hackbios.xyz/)
📢 **Join our Discord:** [https://discord.com/invite/kDpNBsU3qt](https://discord.com/invite/kDpNBsU3qt)
**Follow the HackBIOS 2K26 channel on WhatsApp:** [https://whatsapp.com/channel/0029VbC7IecJENxtS3ob6G0v](https://whatsapp.com/channel/0029VbC7IecJENxtS3ob6G0v)

hackathon_faqs.answer: Any college student with a valid student ID. We also have special prize categories for all-girls teams and first-time hackers.
hackathon_faqs.question: Who can participate?

hackathon_faqs.answer: HackBIOS is completely free! We provide meals, workspace, and a ton of swag. You just need to bring your laptop and energy.
hackathon_faqs.question: How much does it cost?

hackathon_faqs.answer: You can form a team of 2 to 4 members. Solo participations are not allowed.
hackathon_faqs.question: What is the team size?

hackathon_faqs.answer: Yes, absolutely! We will provide regular meals, midnight snacks, and endless coffee to keep you running
hackathon_faqs.question: Will there be food?

hackathon_faqs.answer: Hackathons are the best place to learn! We'll have mentors, workshops, and beginner-friendly resources. Design and presentation skills are equally important.
hackathon_faqs.question: What if I don't know how to code?

hackathon_faqs.answer: HackBIOS 3.0 is fundamentally an offline, in-person hackathon held at Shri Shankaracharya Technical Campus, Bhilai.
hackathon_faqs.question: Is it an online or offline hackathon?

hackathon_faqs.answer: You'll need your laptop, charger, any other hardware you plan to use, and a curious mind! For in-person events, we also recommend a water bottle and any personal items you may need.
hackathon_faqs.question: What do I need to bring?

hackathon_faqs.answer: All projects must be submitted through Devfolio before the final deadline.
hackathon_faqs.question: How do we submit our projects?

hackathon_faqs.answer: Accommodation will not be provided but a common rest area will be given.

hackathon_faqs.answer: No, travel expenses need to be borne by the participants themselves.
